primary_claim: In an exploratory single-user case study, ChatGPT, DeepSeek, and Gemini each produced structured, value-laden 'recommendation letters' evaluating the user when prompted through long-form dialogue, with distinct evaluative styles (technical audit, philosophical characterization, and metaphorical constructs) that the author argues are not captured by current benchmarks.
stated_future_work: invite collaboration on building a user-led evaluation suite for LLMs
compare probes with others who have designed similar interaction-driven probes
limitations_stated: no claim of generalization, only observation
quote: I investigate whether LLMs can produce consistent, structured, and value-laden outputs when prompted to reflect on user behavior.
